title: R1.2 · Shot transitions (4 × 10 min)
instructions: Each item is a candidate shot transition. The six frames go from before (left) to after (right); the middle two are the first and last frame of the proposed transition. Answer transition if the camera shot changes there (hard cut, dissolve, fade, wipe or logo transition, including transitions into or out of replays), and none if it is the same continuous shot (camera motion, zoom, flash, on-screen graphics appearing). The suggestion is a detector consensus, so please check every item.

options.label: Real shot transition (cut, fade, wipe, logo)
